newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Howard says Australia cabinet still mulling media.
newsitem.headline: Howard says Australia cabinet still mulling media.

text.p: Australian Prime Minister John Howard said on Wednesday cabinet had discussed media ownership policy and further talks would resume soon.
"We discussed the matter a little over the last day or two and will be resuming the discussion again shortly," Howard told reporters.
"And, in the meantime, there will be some consultation between the minister and the relevant government party committee," Howard said.
The Liberal-National government is reviewing the media cross-ownership rules, which prevent the owners of a newspaper from owning a television station in the same market.
Australia's second-largest newspaper group, John Fairfax Holdings Ltd, is widely expected to be the target of a bid by media proprietor Kerry Packer if the rules are loosened.
Packer controls Australia's top-rating Nine Network through its Publishing and Broadcasting Ltd.
